gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Noto Sans Glagolitic has a sturdy, tall body and round letters that stay open. Next to Autour One's bold display shapes, a long page would read smoothly, with nothing crowding or snagging along the way.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Expressive Autour One traces every stroke at the width of a single stylus, while Noto Sans Gothic opens huge counters like drilled glass beads. Easy going.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Autour One looks cut from strips of equal width, each glyph a bold, blunt little ribbon. Noto Sans Grantha sits under it with tall, compact letters, so a heading can shout while the text keeps quietly reading on.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Autour One draws like sign-shop vinyl cut to a single line width, bold and unmistakable up top. And Noto Sans Gujarati answers with curved strokes and wide, open counters, which is where the pair is most at ease.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-g: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi has lowercase strokes as tall as a thick crayon mark, with terminals cut back to leave big gaps. And Autour One, with no sparkle and a constant stroke weight, feels sturdier and more insistent beside it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-gurmukhi: Autour One keeps its horizontals as thick as its verticals, which gives its bold shapes a blunt, expressive punch. Noto Sans Gurmukhi follows with outward-pointing terminals, and the heading earns its keep when it runs big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line's height with lowercase. Beside Autour One's rod-built letters, it feels like a sturdy, open-ended companion, both of them direct and friendly rather than fussy.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew reads with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems. And Autour One, with its rope-like consistency in every stem, bowl and tail, supplies the bold display voice above it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-hk: Letters drawn as if with a marker tip give Autour One its bold, expressive look. Noto Sans HK supplies large lowercase forms with brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, so the heading leads and the text follows.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-sans-imperial-: Autour One looks cut from strips of equal width, with a clear channel leading into each round letter and bold expression. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic keeps things approachable below.
